# Persian Poetry MCP Playbook

Curated by Skill Harbor — a battle-tested query playbook for the persian-poetry MCP server: structured search patterns over the Ganjoor corpus (over 130,000 Persian poems), with worked query recipes for poets, forms, and themes. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @erfanbashar1. Honest caveats: this is a playbook, not the server — it requires the separate persian-poetry MCP server installed and connected, plus the Ganjoor index it queries.
